svg.aria-label: How Open TV works: the browser plays video directly from broadcasters; open-tv, on 127.0.0.1 by default, syncs the lists and guides you add by URL, health-checks streams, stores everything in a local SQLite and relays a stream only when the browser can't fetch it.
